Woman Dies After Amusement Ride Mishap at Delhi Dussehra Mela

A 27-year-old woman died after falling from an amusement ride at a Dussehra Mela in Delhi's Vikaspuri. She passed away while undergoing treatment at a hospital. The venue reportedly violated an 11 pm deadline.
